description: Permanently delete a brief and all its saved versions from the user's proofread.law account. The deletion is permanent: it cannot be undone and the text cannot be recovered afterwards. Only call it when the user asks to delete that brief; if the id is in any doubt, confirm it with list_briefs first. Deleting runs no check. Saving is opt-in: nothing is saved unless save_brief or update_brief is called (check_citations and check_document never save anything). A saved brief is stored encrypted in the user's proofread.law account until delete_brief removes it, and needs an API key (PROOFREAD_API_KEY, or one from sign_up).

id.description: The id of the brief to delete, from save_brief or list_briefs.

name: delete_brief
title: Permanently delete a saved brief
